items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Buck was a great teacher for me. ... He showed me runs. ... Buck had taught me that run.

ctx.x: Do you want to get into the Buck and Bubbles?

The bands, when they came to Pittsburgh they'd drive in to my little street on (Wehnwood) street and pick me up and take me out on gigs with them, during the period when the bands used to come to Pittsburgh. By this time I was known as the little piano girl. Everybody called me that and Roland Mayfield had gotten a special made (Ford?) Chrysler with a 4-gear shift on it and he'd given me this car.
